description: This file defines an abstract class AbstractMigration in PHP for database migration management within the OrangeHRM system, including methods to obtain schema, connection, and helper utilities.

classes.name: AbstractMigration
classes.description: Abstract class providing a base for database migration scripts with helper methods for schema management and configuration, requiring subclasses to implement versioning and migration logic.

methods.name: getSchemaManager
methods.description: Returns the schema manager object for database schema operations.

methods.name: createQueryBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new QueryBuilder for constructing database queries.

methods.name: getSchemaHelper
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns a SchemaHelper instance.

methods.name: getDataGroupHelper
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns a DataGroupHelper instance.

methods.name: getLangHelper
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns a LanguageHelper instance.

methods.name: getConfigHelper
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns a ConfigHelper instance.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Abstract method to define schema or data changes; must be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Abstract method to return the migration version; must be implemented by subclasses.
